text: LISA OLKEN Salt Lake City, UT | 303-810-2021 | lisa.olken@gmail.com | LinkedIn-Lisa Olken ________________________________________________________________________________ EXECUTIVE PROFILE Recognized as a trusted, collaborative leader, I am an accomplished PBS media executive highly skilled at interdepartmental communications and aligning station strategy with integrity and empathy. I excel at managing and modernizing existing local programs as well as developing new multi-platform content that better serves today’s audiences with relevant, memorable and meaningful local content. ________________________________________________________________________________ LEADERSHIP STRENGTHS	 • Multi-platform Strategist			• Team Development & Culture Building • Communications Expert			• Revenue & Membership Growth • Creative Thinker & Solutions-Driven		• Community Partnerships & Audience Engagement		_______________________________________________________________________________ PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE Director of Content, PBS Utah | 2016 – 2026 Led a 20+ person production department with a $2M+ annual budget. Transformed a legacy broadcast station into a digital-first, award-winning, public media organization with scalable content such as This Is Utah. Increased audience access for Legislative coverage and political debates by providing ASL and Spanish language translations. Actively engaged with donors and potential donors alongside Development. Developed and executed a weekly political analysis series and public affairs content. Collaborated across departments and was awarded grants from PBS Fundraising, PBS Digital Studios’ In the Margins, and PBS KIDS’ America’s Awesome Kids. Developed new avenues for independent producers, such as Roots, Race & Culture, which also increased new fundraising sources. Station’s membership base increased over 50% during my tenure. Managed contracts, vendors, and confidential informational in accordance with state, federal and grant requirements. Led teams to earn 60+ awards and distributed 10 documentaries nationally. Executive Producer, Rocky Mountain Public Media | 1996 – 2016 Senior content leader responsible for developing, directing, filming and editing media projects. Project lead for local and nationally distributed programs. Produced two Vision Maker Media, grant-funded films with all Native crews, Urban Rez and Red Power Energy and was selected for international cultural diplomacy by the U.S. State Department’s American Film Showcase. Pioneered station’s first all-Black film, Jazz in Five Points and the all-Latino film, La Raza de Colorado: El Movimento as well as the arts & culture series, Arts District. Station’s membership base increased over 40% during my tenure. ________________________________________________________________________________ EDUCATIONAL, LEADERSHIP & AWARD ACHIEVEMENTS PBS Executive Content Management Board, 2022 to 2026 Public Media Women in Leadership COO/CEO Bootcamp, 2022 Women’s Executive Leadership, graduate, 2018 Leadership and Management, certificate, 2019 Indiana University, B.A., Media 31 Regional Emmy Awards, 15 National Awards and 2 International Awards
